name: openbb_earnings
description:
Reported versus estimated EPS history for one company through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.fundamental.historical_eps).
Returns: {symbol, provider, data_points, truncated, earnings: [records with date, period, eps_actual, eps_estimated, surprise]} or {symbol, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; limit (periods; default 8); provider (alpha_vantage, fmp; default alpha_vantage).
Keyless: yf_earnings_history, yf_earnings_dates; another source: av_earnings. Keys: alpha_vantage uses SAJHA's ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY; fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "limit": 4}
